name: Sorcerer (Warcraft)
description_html:
Uses the Player's Handbook sorcerer with Warcraft spell restrictions. Affiliation: any.

Spell Restrictions: No summon monster I–IX or planar binding (those belong to the warlock). Many necromancy spells are restricted to the Necromancer (Alliance & Horde Compendium). See Warcraft Cosmology.

Spell List: Inherits the PHB sorcerer list (minus banned conjurations) and adds WRPG arcane spells.

name: Healer
description_html:
New core divine caster (Wis; prepared). Affiliation: any. Hit Die d8; 4 skill points. Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor.

Spells: Prepares divine spells from the healer list. Needs Wisdom 10 + spell level. Save DC = 10 + spell level + Wis modifier. Spends 1 hour/day in quiet contemplation to prepare spells. Does not gain bonus domain slots beyond normal spells/day.

Spontaneous Casting: Good healers can convert prepared spells into cure spells of equal or lower level. Evil healers convert into inflict spells. Neutral healers choose cure or inflict at creation (permanent).

Healing Touch or Evil Touch: Good: Healing domain granted power (+1 caster level with Healing-domain spells). Evil: Evil domain granted power. Neutral chooses one at creation. No extra domain slot.

Brew Potion: Bonus feat at 1st level.

Bonus Feats: At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th: item creation, metamagic, or Spell Focus (must meet prerequisites).

Spell List: Includes PHB cleric-style spells plus WRPG spells such as healing rain, death coil, moonglaive, rejuvenation, second soul, and touch of life. Full list membership is applied via spell-class links.

name: Scout
description_html:
New core wilderness warrior (favored class of night elves). Affiliation: any. Hit Die d8; 6 skill points; good Fort/Ref. Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields.

Track: Bonus Track feat at 1st level.

Nature Sense (Ex): At 1st: +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival.

Wild Healing (Ex): At 2nd: with 5 ranks Survival, spend 1 hour and make a DC 15 Survival check to prepare a wilderness poultice. Then make a Heal check (DC 10); subject recovers 1 hp per point over 10. Once/subject/day. Competence bonus to that Heal check +5 at 6th, +10 at 10th, +15 at 14th, +20 at 18th.

Woodland Stride (Ex): At 3rd: move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment.

Trackless Step (Ex): At 4th: leave no trail in natural surroundings unless desired.

Uncanny Dodge (Ex): At 4th: retain Dex bonus to AC when flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

Trap Sense (Ex): At 5th: +1 Reflex vs traps and +1 dodge AC vs traps; +1 every three levels thereafter (max +6 at 20th).

Spell-Like Abilities: Locate object 1/day (6th), locate creature 1/day (11th), commune with nature 1/day (13th), find the path 1/day (16th), wind walk 1/day (20th). Caster level = scout level.

Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex): At 7th: cannot be flanked (except by a rogue with 4+ more rogue levels than scout levels).

Swift Tracker (Ex): At 8th: track at normal speed without the -5 penalty.

Venom Immunity (Su): At 9th: immune to organic poisons.

Evasion (Ex): At 12th: no damage on a successful Reflex save for half (light or no armor).

name: Tinker
description_html:
New core technological expert (favored class of goblins). Affiliation: any. Hit Die d6; 8 skill points. Proficient with all simple weapons (no armor proficiency).

Bonus Technology Feats: At 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th: bonus Technology feat (must meet prerequisites), including Build Firearms, Build Siege Weapons, Build Small Devices, and Build Vehicles.

Scavenge (Ex): At 1st: jury-rig devices on the fly (+10 Craft DC) using scavenged parts in 1/10 normal time. Bonus +2 at 4th and every 4 levels thereafter (max +10 at 20th). Duration of a scavenged device equals tinker level in uses or hours.

Bomb-Bouncing (Ex): At 2nd: grenade-like weapons have double range increment when thrown with spin.

Evasion (Ex): At 2nd: no damage on a successful Reflex save for half (light or no armor).

Coolness Under Fire (Ex): At 3rd: take 10 on checks to operate or build mechanical devices even when stressed, 1/day; +1/day every 3 levels (max 6/day at 18th).

Fire Resistance (Ex): At 4th: fire resistance 5; +5 every 5 levels thereafter (10/15/20 at 9th/14th/19th).

Improved Evasion (Ex): At 11th: no damage on successful Reflex save for half, half damage on a failed save.

name: Beastmaster
description_html:
Horde or night elf animal companion prestige class. Full BAB; d12 HD. Proficient with simple and martial weapons and light and medium armor.

Animal Companion (Ex): At 1st: as PHB druid animal companion, using beastmaster level.

Wild Empathy (Ex): At 1st: improve animal attitude as Diplomacy; 1d20 + class level + Cha.

Animal Friendship (Sp): At 2nd: befriend additional animals whose total HD do not exceed class level, 1/day.

Empathic Link (Su): At 3rd: empathic link with companion out to 1 mile.

Natural Weaponry (Su): At 4th: grow claws and bite/gore (size-based damage); improved at 7th.

Speak with Animals (Su): At 5th: as speak with animals at will with animals and magical beasts.

Magic Fang (Sp): At 6th: magic fang on companion 1/day (2/day at 8th; greater magic fang 3/day at 10th).

Scry on Companion (Sp): At 9th: scry on companion 1/day.

name: Druid of the Wild
description_html:
Night elf/tauren nature prestige class. +1 divine caster level each class level. Casts from the Druid of the Wild list and the healer list. May spontaneously cast summon nature's ally. No metal armor.

Green Sleep (Ex): At 1st: hibernate into the Emerald Dream at will; body needs no food, water, or air.

Wild Shape (Su): At 1st: storm crow 1/day; additional uses and forms (stag, nightsaber, dire bear, treant) as levels advance.

Woodland Stride / Nature Sense / Trackless Step: As listed on the advancement table.

Venom Immunity / Timeless Body / Dreamwalking: At 5th / 7th / 10th respectively.

Spell List: Adds WRPG spells such as roar, thorn shield, and force of nature, plus a printed nature list.

name: Elven Ranger
description_html:
Alliance elven archery prestige class (high elf ranger / night elf sentinel). Own divine spell list (Wis). Full BAB.

Extended Range (Ex): Each level adds +10 ft. to bow/crossbow range increment.

Favored Enemy (Ex): At 1st and odd levels thereafter, as PHB ranger (Warcraft creature options).

Archery Combat Style: Rapid Shot (1st), Manyshot (6th), Improved Precise Shot (10th) without prerequisites while in light or no armor.

Other Features: Heightened perception, woodland stride, keen arrows, swift tracker, bow strike, anticipation, arrow cleave.

Spell List: Own 1st–4th list including sentinel.

name: Gladiator
description_html:
Arena champion (Alliance gladiator / Horde blademaster). Full BAB; d10 HD. Proficient with simple and martial weapons and light and medium armor.

Supreme Cleave (Ex): At 1st: may take a 5-ft. step between Cleave/Great Cleave attacks once/round.

Command (Ex): At 2nd: rally allies within 20 ft. for a morale bonus on attacks (+1 to +5 by level), 1/day.

description_html:
